'''Imperial Munitions''' was a weapons manufacturer affiliated with the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]]. As a holding company, Imperial Munitions produced from a diverse portfolio of products, but also served the political function of protecting Imperial manufacturing interests from dissension or sale.

When [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] came under suspicion from providing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] with arms, the firm sought an exclusive production contract with the Empire to clear its name. In the years to follow, other products were added via nationalized firms, exclusive contracts through existing partnerships, and internally produced products.

Without a threat of order to hold the corporate entity together, Imperial Munitions collapsed into its individual segments as the Empire fell, leaving an array of factories and firms with elements of Imperial technology.
